Shake residue verification deviated from the literal plan command: scripts/check-shake-residue.sh --list requires the entire Cslib facade target to have fresh oleans to even begin its analysis, which crosses into the explicitly prohibited full lake build (confirmed live: lake shake errored 'target is out-of-date and needs to be rebuilt' on the Cslib facade after 3324/3325 build jobs). The wrapper script silently reports a false clean (exit 0, zero flagged lines) in this failure mode because the error text does not match its flagged-file regex -- a real latent bug in check-shake-residue.sh, out of scope to fix. Substituted 'lake shake --add-public --keep-implied --keep-prefix --force Cslib.Logics.Propositional.Tableau.Intuitionistic' (--force is shake's own documented flag to skip its internal build-freshness gate, scoped to the already-freshly-built changed module): exit 0, zero output, which per shake's documented exit-code semantics (0 = no suggestions) is a real, trustworthy confirmation of zero import-minimization issues in the changed file's transitive closure. Full deviation rationale recorded inline in the plan file and in the summary.
